title: ServiceNow-utvecklare
description:
Vilka är vi?
Unibase är ett växande IT-företag med passion för att skapa värde för våra kunder genom smarta tekniska lösningar. Vi arbetar med spännande projekt och samarbetar med kunniga kollegor. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och göra skillnad genom att utveckla och förvalta lösningar i ServiceNow-plattformen.
Om rollen
Vi söker en erfaren ServiceNow-utvecklare till Unibase!
Som ServiceNow-utvecklare kommer du bland annat att:
Utveckla, konfigurera och anpassa lösningar i ServiceNow-plattformen
Arbeta med moduler som Incident, Problem, Change, CMDB och Service Catalog
Säkerställa att lösningarna följer best practice och kundens behov
Delta i projekt för implementation, integration och vidareutveckling av plattformen
Samarbeta med kollegor inom ITSM, utveckling och arkitektur

Du blir en viktig del av vårt och kundens team och bidrar till att leverera effektiva och framtidssäkra ITSM-lösningar.
Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bestå av följande (beroende på uppdrag):
Utveckling och konfiguration:
Skapa och anpassa workflows, business rules, UI policies och script
Implementera integrationer med externa system via API:er
Utveckla rapporter och dashboards för uppföljning och analys

Förvaltning och optimering:
Underhålla befintliga lösningar och säkerställa hög tillgänglighet
Felsöka och åtgärda problem i plattformen
Dokumentera konfigurationer och förändringar

Projekt och innovation:
Delta i design och implementation av nya moduler och funktioner
Bidra med idéer kring automatisering och effektivisering
Arbeta med uppgraderingar och nya versioner av ServiceNow

Meriterande erfarenheter
Det är positivt om du har erfarenhet av:
Certifieringar inom ServiceNow (t.ex. Certified System Administrator, Application Developer)
ITIL v4 eller liknande ramverk för IT-styrning
Scriptning i JavaScript och kunskap om REST API
Integrationer mot andra ITSM-verktyg eller affärssystem

Din bakgrund
Vi söker dig som har:
Minst 5 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom ServiceNow-utveckling
God förståelse för ITSM-processer och ServiceNow-arkitektur
Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande erfarenhet
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt

Varför ska du bli en del av vår familj?
Vårt engagemang för mångfald och inkludering
Vi värdesätter mångfald och strävar efter att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö. Alla kvalificerade sökande uppmuntras att ansöka, oavsett kön, ålder, etnicitet, religion, funktionsvariation eller sexuell läggning. Vi tror att olika perspektiv berikar vårt team och vår verksamhet.

title: Entry Level: Software Developer - Packet Core
description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   Here at Ericsson, we are not just imagining the future—we are building it. Join us in developing state-of-the-art technology for 5G, 6G, and beyond.
  
 About the opportunity Are you a recent graduate or an early-career software developer looking to build a rewarding career in technology? We are looking for several Software Developers to join our department as we take on exciting new challenges. We are on a mission to develop 5G, 6G, and future communication technologies—creating telecom solutions that empower billions of people worldwide. Our technologies enable applications such as remote healthcare, smart cities, autonomous vehicles, and new enterprise solutions. You will join a team of dedicated, curious, and self-motivated engineers who thrive in an environment of collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. Located at our lively office in Lindholmen, Gothenburg, with a stunning view of the Göta Älv river, we combine technical expertise with a passion for improving the world—and having fun while doing it.
  
 What you will do We are looking for Software Developers to join our cross-functional team and contribute to the development of world-class telecom products. This is an opportunity to work on software that makes a real difference while developing your skills in a high-impact and innovative environment. You will work with the design and development of fast, efficient, and well-structured software for the user plane in Ericsson’s packet core solutions. Our microservices are deployed in cloud environments, giving you hands-on experience with cloud technologies, containerized systems, and modern software tools such as Git and continuous integration pipelines.
 Together with the team, you will contribute to the complete feature-development process—from initial studies and design to implementation, testing, and delivery. You will collaborate with colleagues to explore new technical solutions, challenge existing approaches, and develop features using modern technologies. We are particularly interested in candidates who have a strong interest in telecom solutions in general and packet core technologies in particular. Previous experience in telecom or packet core is not required, but you should be curious and motivated to learn more about this domain and build your career within it. We value curiosity, a can-do attitude, and a willingness to try new approaches. You will also have the opportunity to explore AI-driven software development and use AI tools to support your learning, problem-solving, and everyday development work. The main programming language is C, and all team members participate in the initial system testing of the team’s deliverables.
  
 The skills you bring  A BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
 Good programming skills, preferably in C or a similar language such as C++, Rust, or Go
 Experience with Linux or UNIX environments
 An interest in software development and problem-solving
 A strong interest in telecom solutions, packet core, or communication networks—or a clear curiosity and willingness to learn more about these areas
 A willingness to learn, collaborate, and take on new challenges
 An interest in artificial intelligence and AI-agent development
 An interest in learning more about the telecommunications industry
  
 
 Meritorious qualifications Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas is an advantage:
  Cloud and container technologies, such as Docker, Kubernetes, GCP, Amazon EKS, OpenStack, or VMware
 Real-time software development
 AI-agent development
 Networking, including L2/L3 protocols, VPN, 3GPP standards, TCP, UDP, L2TP, or TLS
 Packet core, datacom, or telecommunications
 Python programming

title: System Manager | Early Career Program
description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   About this opportunity   Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research, Product Development, Data, and AI  contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward. This isn’t a programme where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. Your journey within the Innovate Program will start as System Manager at Business Area Core Network in Gothenburg. 
     What you will do   This is an opportunity to build a strong foundation in 5G Core, 6G evolution and end-to-end systems while developing towards future technical leadership.You will work at the intersection of technology, innovation and business. You will explore emerging technologies, take part in system-level studies, contribute to technical direction and learn how ideas become standards, products and customer value.•    Participate in system studies on 5GC/6G evolution, new capabilities and emerging use cases.•    Analyse technology trends, research, customer needs and business priorities, and help turn them into requirements, architecture options and recommendations.•    Contribute to 3GPP-related reviews, technical discussions and standardization activities, especially in areas relevant to Packet Core and end-to-end network evolution.•    Explore end-to-end scenarios such as mobility, interworking, enterprise and IoT, network slicing, edge, roaming, QoS and resilience.•    Assess impacts on interfaces, performance, operations, security, lifecycle, migration and customer value.•    Work with architects, product management, development, research, standardization and customer-facing teams across Ericsson.•    Help connect standardization and innovation to product realization, verification, deployment and customer impact.•    Participate in root-cause analyses and learn from complex technical cases.•    Use AI-assisted methods responsibly for technology exploration, standards analysis, requirements and technical material—always validating results and protecting confidential information.•    Bring your own ideas to innovation workshops and contribute to idea incubation.Your development journey will be shaped together with you. The goal is to help you grow into roles such as Technology Specialist, innovation leader, technical coordinator, program lead or another future technical-leadership position.
  
 You will bring 
 •    A Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, mathematics or a related technical discipline.•    Strong technical competence, analytical skills and the ability to learn quickly.•    Curiosity about telecom, cloud-native systems, AI, networking and the evolution towards 6G.•    An innovative, entrepreneurial and creative mindset, with the energy to explore ideas and turn them into practical outcomes.•    A collaborative and communicative approach—you enjoy working with people from different technical and business backgrounds.•    An interest in connecting technology to customer value, portfolio decisions and business impact.•    Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.
 In addition, you have: Experience with 5G Core, Packet Core, 3GPP, Kubernetes, CNFs, cloud platforms, CI/CD, performance, service assurance or 6G studies is valuable, but not required. What matters most is your potential, motivation and willingness to take on complex challenges.

title: Join Our Team as a SW Engineer
description:
About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Automotive Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for the full software development lifecycle of embedded systems for automotive applications, from requirement analysis through to qualification testing. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and work independently to deliver high-quality software components.
Key Responsibilities
·      Analyze software and hardware requirements for automotive embedded systems.
·      Design system architecture, detailed modules, and software interfaces.
·      Develop, test, and integrate embedded software, including hardware drivers and bootloaders.
·      Conduct unit testing, integration testing, and qualification testing in compliance with automotive standards.
·      Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support system bring-up and debugging.
·      Document design specifications and test procedures.
·      Work efficiently both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
What You'll Bring
·      3+ years of experience in automotive embedded systems development.
·      Proficient in C/C++ programming; scripting experience in Python, Shell, or Perl.
·      Strong understanding of microcontrollers, device drivers, and embedded systems.
·      Hands-on experience with bootloaders, cross compilers, and toolchains.
·      Familiarity with software development lifecycle and working with hardware manuals, schematics, and data sheets.
·      Practical experience with automotive communication protocols: SPI, CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet.
·      Experience with debugging tools, simulators, emulators, and test equipment.
·      Team player with excellent self-management and communication skills.
Nice to Have
·      Experience with AUTOSAR Classic Platform development.
·      Familiarity with AUTOSAR Configuration Tools (e.g., DaVinci, ECU Spectrum).
·      Understanding of Functional Safety concepts (ISO 26262).
·      Experience with multi-threaded and multitasking systems.
·      Knowledge of Automotive SPICE or CMMI frameworks.
Benefits & Perks:
·      Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
·      Health, dental, and vision insurance.
·      Flexible work hours and remote work options.
·      Learning and development opportunities
.      Work with a talented and passionate team in a collaborative environment.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer to Markem-Imaje
employer: ANTS Akademiskt Nätverk av Tekniska Studenter AB
description:
About Us
Markem-Imaje is a trusted world manufacturer of product identification and traceability solutions, offering a full range of reliable and innovative inkjet, thermal transfer, laser, print and label application systems. Markem-Imaje delivers fully integrated solutions that enable product quality and safety, regulatory and retailer compliance, better product recalls and improved manufacturing processes.
Markem-Imaje Sweden in Gothenburg is something as unusual as a small innovation and development hub with a startup mindset within an established global company.
Our mission is to lead the development of new innovative products and solutions, from concept to production with the freedom to use the work methods we find most efficient. We love what we do, and we have help from the global organization we are a part of.
The Role
As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer at Markem-Imaje, you get to work at the heart of our Print & Apply platform, as part of a small team in an international context where ideas move quickly from discussion to implementation and everyone's technical input matters.
In this role, you will:

Be directly involved in and influence important technical decisions for the development of our Print & Apply products.


Work close to the hardware you are building software for, developing a system level understanding of how your code interacts with the motors, sensors, and electronics around it.


Collaborate with the wider team, both locally and across the global organization, drawing on their experience while helping shape the direction of the products you work on.

What You Will Do
The role involves hands on coding, mainly in C++ in a Linux environment, developing the controller software that runs our Print & Apply products. You will work close to the hardware, from motors and sensors to the electronics that drive them, testing and troubleshooting your own code together with the team.
Beyond the core C++ development, you will have the possibility to:

Develop interfaces in Golang.


Develop motor control in C on FreeRTOS.


Collaborate closely with the electronics and mechanics teams to test and troubleshoot hardware related issues.


Take part in code reviews and contribute to improving the quality of the codebase together with the team.

What You Need To Have
Bachelor's degree with significant professional experience developing software; a Master's degree is highly desired but not essential.


Senior experience in embedded development, mainly in C++.


Experience with low level programming, sensors, and motor control.


Comfortable making technical decisions and driving development forward in collaboration with a small team in an international context.


Basic understanding of physics, for example through relevant university education.


Experience with Go programming and previous work with Linux ARM processors would be advantageous.
If you believe you match our values and have the experience we're looking for, then apply as we review applications on a rolling basis! We can't wait to hear from you!

title: Senior Developer to Relay Software Team
description:
About Us
Mullvad VPN is a Swedish VPN company dedicated to fighting mass surveillance and censorship. We do this primarily through our VPN service and our privacy-focused web browser. Over the years, we have been pioneers when it comes to VPN technology and we intend to remain trailblazers. Everything we do is built with our users’ security and privacy first — with the ambition of making mass surveillance and censorship impractical.
The Job
We're looking for a Senior Developer to join our Relay Software Team at Mullvad. This team is responsible for all custom software solutions used on our VPN relays.
You'll play a key role in advancing server support for technologies such as Quantum-secure tunnels, traffic-analysis protection and protocol obfuscation.
Who Are You
You're someone who enjoys working in a team, contributes ideas proactively, and has a strong interest in security, networks and low-level software development.
You value quality, maintainability, and thoughtful software design. You are curious and eager to learn, and you understand the importance of digital privacy.
Responsibilities
Work on new and exciting technologies and greenfield projects.


Using Go, design and implement robust server software for running on Linux.


Author clean solutions that balance performance and resource usage.


Perform measurements, testing and troubleshooting.


Coordinate with stakeholders and developers in other departments.

Qualifications
Excellent written and spoken English and Swedish.


Highly developed understanding of software design and all aspects of software implementation.


Experience with building server software.


Excellent understanding of networking fundamentals.


Strong knowledge in at least one of C/Go/Rust.

Why Mullvad?
We value quality over quantity and believe in good solutions rather than quick fixes. Our apps are open source, our teams are curious and collaborative, and we care deeply about removing bloat rather than adding it.
We are a bunch of diversified peeps: from vegans to marathon runners, audiophiles to farmers and coffee brewers. So, what unites us? Our commitment to living and breathing our mission, to make mass surveillance and censorship impractical. 
If you want to build products that make an impact, enjoy generous benefits, and work for a purpose you can stand behind, welcome to Mullvad.
Additional Information
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden Start: As soon as possible Job Hours: Full-time, hybrid 60% on-site position
This is an ongoing recruitment process and we aim to fill the position as soon as possible. Please note that due to the holiday season, there may be some delays in our response times. We appriciate your patience and will get back to you as soon as possible. 
As part of our hiring process, we conduct a background check to ensure a safe and secure work environment.

title: Customer & Product Specialist
description:
Customer & Product Specialist — bli en av våra första i Sverige
Artigan är ett ungt, svenskt AI-first-bolag som bygger moderna SaaS-, app- och webblösningar för resebranschen. Produkten finns, används av kunder och utvecklas hela tiden. Nu ska den bli ännu enklare, smartare och bättre — och nå fler. Därför söker vi två personer som ska jobba nära både våra kunder och vår produkt.
Du kommer in tidigt och jobbar tätt med grundaren och utvecklingsteamet, och får en ovanligt bred inblick i hur ett modernt SaaS-bolag faktiskt drivs — från kundproblem och produktbeslut till AI, testning och förbättringar. Bakom Artigan står en grundare som byggt SaaS-bolag tidigare.
Det här kan mycket väl vara ditt första riktiga jobb. Vi bryr oss betydligt mer om hur snabbt du förstår saker, hur du löser problem och vad du faktiskt får gjort än om vilken utbildning eller titel du haft tidigare.
Rollen Du är länken mellan kunden, produkten och utvecklingsteamet. Ena stunden hjälper du en kund som har fastnat i systemet. Nästa stund testar du en ny funktion, försöker förstå varför något inte fungerar som tänkt, spelar in en kort instruktionsvideo eller beskriver en förbättring som utvecklarna ska bygga. Hos oss är "jag har skickat det vidare" inte samma sak som att något är klart — du följer problemet hela vägen tills kunden eller produkten faktiskt har en fungerande lösning.
 Du kommer bland annat att:

använda AI som ett naturligt arbetsverktyg: research, problemlösning, dokumentation, testning, analys och prototyper


ha löpande kontakt med kunder och ge snabb, personlig support


reagera direkt när en kund behöver hjälp — även om du inte har lösningen ännu


förstå vad kunden säger, men också vad kunden egentligen behöver


felsöka tillsammans med utvecklingsteamet och driva frågan hela vägen till lösning


testa nya funktioner, försöka slå sönder dem och avgöra om de verkligen är klara


se när något fungerar tekniskt men ändå är onödigt krångligt för användaren


beskriva förbättringar på ett sätt som utvecklarna kan agera på


skapa dokumentation, hjälpmaterial och korta support- och produktvideor


hjälpa nya kunder att komma igång 


Vem du är Du ser ett problem och börjar ta reda på hur det går att lösa, utan att vänta på en detaljerad instruktion. Du spelar hellre in en snabb Loom än skriver ett långt mejl och du blir irriterad när en bugg får ligga kvar utan att någon gör något åt den.
Du lär dig snabbt och är tekniskt orädd. Du behöver inte vara utvecklare, men ett API, en integration eller ett okänt system ska väcka nyfikenhet snarare än få dig att tänka "det där får någon teknisk person ta" — och du kan förklara en teknisk sak för en kund utan att blinka. Du gillar kunder och får energi av att hjälpa människor; hör någon av sig är din instinkt att svara snabbt och börja lösa, inte att lägga ärendet i en kö. Du har produktkänsla — ser när ett flöde är krångligt eller ologiskt, även när det fungerar tekniskt. Och du trivs med flera saker igång samtidigt: en supportfråga, ett kundmöte, ett funktionstest och en uppföljning under samma dag — och tycker det är roligare än jobbigt.
AI är redan en självklar del av hur du arbetar. För oss betyder AI-native mer än att använda ChatGPT för att formulera texter — du använder AI för att faktiskt få saker gjorda: förstå problem, researcha, testa idéer, automatisera, prototypa och förbättra i korta feedbackloopar. Du har sannolikt redan byggt eller automatiserat något med verktyg som Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Lovable eller Google AI Studio, bara för att du tyckte att det borde gå att göra smartare.
 Så jobbar vi Artigan är ett litet bolag med korta beslutsvägar och högt tempo. Vi bygger, testar, lär oss och förbättrar hela tiden, och AI är en naturlig del av hur vi får mer gjort. Vi löser hellre ett kundproblem idag än diskuterar i tre möten om vem som ansvarar för det. Det här passar inte dig som behöver en färdig rollbeskrivning och tydliga överlämningar — det passar dig som gillar ansvar, tempo och friheten att själv lista ut hur något bäst blir löst.
 Praktiskt

Placering: vårt kontor centralt i Göteborg, med viss möjlighet att jobba hemifrån.


Anställning: tillsvidare, med tjänstepension, försäkringar, friskvård och en egen budget för din utveckling. Vi tillämpar provanställning (6 månader).


Lön: sätts utifrån din erfarenhet och vad du tillför.


Språk: du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska. Engelska används dagligen i samarbetet med utvecklingsteamet.


 Så söker du Skicka ett enkelt CV och  en kort video, någon minut lång, där du presenterar dig och vad som lockar. Beskriv gärna något du gjort med AI nyligen, verktyg du använda och hur du arbetade dig fram. 

 
Om Artigan Artigan är ett svenskt AI-first-bolag som bygger moderna SaaS-, app- och webblösningar för resebranschen. Vår plattform hjälper researrangörer att automatisera sådant som annars kräver mycket manuellt arbete, ge sina kunder bättre service och arbeta smartare. Vi är ett litet team, gillar korta beslutsvägar, och tror att kombinationen av bra produktförståelse, nära kundkontakt och modern AI kan förändra hur en hel bransch arbetar.

title: System Developer - Portfolio Investments Applications
description:
Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!
About The Role
As a System Developer at Myntro, you'll join our DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you'll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.
Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You'll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You'll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.
In this role, you will:

Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.


Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.


Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.


Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.


Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.


Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

Who You Are
We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You're comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.
You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You're pragmatic and collaborative, but you don't wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.
AI-assisted development isn't new to you; it's already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you're paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We're actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.
We see that you likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.


Minimum 5 years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.


Strong .NET/C# development skills.


Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.


Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.


Good communication skills in Swedish and English.


Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you're interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.
Why join Myntro?
At Myntro, you'll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.
This is a good place if you are looking for variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to combine software development with architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, and real business problems. You'll be part of a team that's expected to think, build, operate, and improve together.
Our culture is built on care, accountability, and the belief that the best results come from working together. Collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability, and simplicity are how we actually make decisions, not just words on a wall.
Interested? Welcome to apply!
Sounds like your next challenge? We review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so don't wait too long to apply. The role is full-time and based at our head office in central Gothenburg.
For questions regarding the role or recruitment process, please contact Lema Naderi, our Talent Acquisition Specialist – lema.naderi@myntro.com 
We look forward to receiving your application!

Customer Zero is the Coretura canary OEM: a real, production-shaped tenant run as if it were an external customer, with its own identities, its own network, and its own access boundary, outside the internal Coretura network. You will team up with our Customer Zero Lead and work closely with Quality Release Engineers and own the technical cloud domain of the simulated customer environment. 
Communication is at the heart of the role. Customer Zero sits between teams, so you will spend much of your time sharing what you find, explaining why it matters, and aligning developers and stakeholders around it. You communicate in a way that builds trust and brings people together.

The fun part is that nothing written above is set in stone. It will change, it must change, as we learn more and the demands on us grow. You are part of that ride.

title: Senior Scientist - Clinical AI
description:
About AstraZeneca and AISI
At AstraZeneca, technology and science meet to change what is possible for patients. Within AISI, the BioPharma Clinical Development AI team is building world-class AI capability to accelerate the design, conduct, and analysis of clinical trials across our BioPharmaceuticals pipeline, in both early and late phase programmes. We partner closely with clinical development, regulatory, and biometrics teams to bring better treatments to patients faster, while adhering to the highest evidentiary standards.
The Opportunity
Clinical development is one of the most data-rich and decision-intensive parts of bringing a new medicine to patients. Trial design, patient selection, dose optimisation, biomarker strategy, and safety evaluation are all areas where AI and machine learning can add rigour, speed, and precision, as a powerful complement to clinical and statistical expertise.
You will work in cross-functional teams across the key BioPharmaceuticals disease areas of cardiovascular, renal, metabolic disease, respiratory, and immunology. Alongside experienced data scientists and clinical collaborators, you will apply modern AI methods to measurably advance the drug pipeline and help build reusable approaches that scale across programmes.
Foundation models, agentic systems, and causal AI are advancing rapidly, and the regulatory and methodological frameworks around them are evolving in parallel. In this role you will be hands-on at the frontier, developing, evaluating, and deploying AI methods that directly inform clinical trial design and decision-making. Every model you contribute to will eventually touch a trial that decides whether a patient gets a better therapy. That is the bar we hold ourselves to.
What You'll Do
* Develop and deploy AI/ML methods for clinical trials, including trial design support, dose optimisation, biomarker discovery, digital twins, predictive modelling, and safety and efficacy signal detection
* Contribute to end-to-end project delivery, from problem framing and methodology selection through to validation and adoption within study teams, with guidance from senior colleagues on more complex initiative.
* Partner with Clinical Development, Biometrics, and Regulatory colleagues to embed AI approaches into study design and decision-making
* Build reusable, well-documented data products such as pipelines, packages, and applications, with a software engineering mindset
* Apply modern methodologies including foundation models, agentic AI, generative patient models, longitudinal modelling, Bayesian inference, and causal inference, with clear evaluation criteria
* Practise data-centric AI and contribute to evaluation and benchmarking frameworks suitable for clinical and regulatory settings
* Engage with internal and external scientific communities, contributing to publications and conference presentations
Essential Requirements
* A degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, Physics, Engineering) at Master's, or PhD level, or equivalent experience
* Demonstrated experience in AI/ML method development, shown through delivered models, publications, open-source contributions, or applied projects, ideally in clinical, biomedical, or drug development settings
* Hands-on experience with biological or clinical data, such as molecular (DNA, RNA, protein), imaging, or clinical text (EHR, clinical notes)
* Technical capability in one or more modern AI areas, such as foundation model training and fine-tuning, Bayesian inference, temporal and longitudinal modelling, multimodal integration, model interpretability, or post-training and alignment
* Strong Python skills, experience with PyTorch and modern LLM tooling, and familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex methods into actionable insights for clinical, regulatory, and scientific audiences
Desirable Skills and Experience
* Exposure to clinical development, such as trial design, biomarkers, dosing, safety, endpoints, or regulatory processes
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, uncertainty quantification, or clinical AI benchmarking
* Peer-reviewed publications in clinical AI, computational drug development, or machine learning
How You Work
* You are comfortable using, but not over-relying on, agentic AI tools to augment your work.
* You keep up with the latest AI research and try out new tools and methods without waiting to be directed.
Work policy
When we put people in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. This role is located in Gothenburg, Sweden and is not available for remote work or with travel or commuting support.

Wheel loaders and other construction machines operate on rough, unstructured and dynamic terrain where the ground is deformable, obstacles appear and disappear, and people and vehicles move nearby. Our systems create value the moment their output reaches the customer's control system — a correction, a signal, something the line can act on.
What determines the results are a handful of decisions made early and made well: which signal, where it lands, what the line does with it, and how it behaves when something unexpected happens. Get those right and the implementation is small and quick.
Today that judgement is distributed between our own team and the automation partners we work with on each installation. We want someone to decide what the interface should look like, judge whether it came out right, decide when a sensor or other component needs replacing, and if the signal belongs on a different fieldbus.

Own the machine-side interface. You decide how our system talks to the customer's PLC. Signals, timing, handshakes, watchdog, fail-safe behaviour. You write the functional description the work is built from.
Lead our automation partners. Sometimes that means writing the code snippet yourself. Sometimes it means explaining what needs doing and reviewing that it came out right. You decide which.
Make the technical decisions on the customer's plant. Upgrading a component for better results, or moving to a different fieldbus, is yours to propose and drive. The implementation itself normally goes to a partner.
Be the customer's main contact through the project — scope, timeline, status, time and cost reporting. You take over from sales and carry the delivery home.
Clear the path. OT network access, change control, and the dialogue with the site's automation and IT departments, so the installation can be done quickly and safely.
Work closely with our ML and vision engineers. Translate what the process needs into what the model has to output, and the model's limits back into what we can promise.
Make it repeatable. A reusable interface specification, a commissioning checklist, and a growing network of automation partners to deliver alongside.

You have programmed PLCs in live production, on at least one major platform — Siemens TIA/S7, Beckhoff, ABB, Mitsubishi, Codesys or equivalent

You have stood on site during commissioning, with production running and someone waiting

Swedish and English, and you sometimes travel to sites

Python and basic data analysis
